title: Star Premium Versus Squad Depth: Where Should Delhi Capitals Spend Its Budget?
dek: Should Delhi Capitals concentrate their budget on a few stars or spread it across a deep squad? Contribution per crore by price tier tests the trade-off.
excerpt: Since 2018, Delhi Capitals' ₹10 Cr and above tier has returned the most tempo runs per crore. Here is where their money has gone and what it bought.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: {{ev:sp-top-share}} of Delhi Capitals' recorded spend since 2018 went on players priced ₹10 Cr or more; {{ev:sp-low-share}} on players under ₹2 Cr.
Tempo runs above average per crore: {{ev:sp-top-per}} in the top tier, {{ev:sp-mid-per}} in the middle, {{ev:sp-low-per}} at the bottom.
The best-returning tier has been ₹10 Cr and above.

sections.heading: Stars or Depth
body: The salary cap forces a choice. A franchise can pay a premium for a few proven match-winners, or spread the money across more good players. Each strategy fails differently: stars leave gaps when injured; depth can lack a match-winner.
Since 2018, Delhi Capitals have spent {{ev:sp-top-share}} of their recorded budget on players priced ₹10 Cr or more, {{ev:sp-mid-share}} in the ₹2–10 Cr range and {{ev:sp-low-share}} below ₹2 Cr.

sections.heading: What Each Tier Returned
body: Measured in tempo runs above average per crore, the top tier returned {{ev:sp-top-per}}, the middle tier {{ev:sp-mid-per}} and the bottom tier {{ev:sp-low-per}}.
The ₹10 Cr and above tier has given DC the best return per crore. Low-priced players who never play count at zero, which pulls the bottom tier down.

sections.heading: Balancing the Book
body: The right mix depends on where the surplus comes from. If cheap players regularly produce, depth is efficient; if they rarely play, the money is better concentrated on players who will.
For DC, the tier table is the guide to which end of the market has delivered.

sections.heading: What the Model Leaves Out
body: Tempo runs ignore wickets and dismissals, so anchors and wicket-taking bowlers are undervalued, and stars often fill exactly those roles.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Fund the Tier That Delivers
body: Delhi Capitals have had the best return from the ₹10 Cr and above tier. Future auctions should weight the budget towards the tier that has converted money into contribution, while protecting the roles stars uniquely fill.
Adding a survival term to the model would make the comparison fairer to anchors and wicket-takers.

seo.metaTitle: Star premium versus squad depth at DC
seo.metaDescription: Where Delhi Capitals have spent their auction budget since 2018, and which price tier has returned the most contribution per crore.

methodology: Contribution is tempo runs above average (tRAA): batting runs above what an average batter would score from the same balls in the same season and phase, plus bowling runs saved against the average bowler in the same season and phase. Wickets and dismissals are not valued in this version. Prices come from CricField squad lists (₹ crore = 100 lakh). Generated by scripts/editorial/engine.
